charset.description: Character set: 'hex' (default), 'hex-upper', 'base64url', 'alphanumeric' (base62), 'alphabetic', 'numeric', or 'safe' (alphanumeric minus look-alike 0/O/1/l/I). Ignored when custom_chars is set.

custom_chars.description: Optional custom alphabet: when non-empty, tokens are drawn from these characters (duplicates removed, min 2 distinct) instead of the charset preset.
